import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with brand colors
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
brands = df['brand'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(brands))
for i, brand in enumerate(brands):
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                s=brand_data['weight_grams']/5, alpha=0.7, 
                label=brand, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(Size = Weight)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Model year timeline
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.scatter(df['model_year'], df['price_usd'], c=df['megapixels'], 
            s=100, cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax2.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Price Over Years\n(Color = Megapixels)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax2.collections[0], ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Megapixels', fontsize=8)

# 3. Weight vs Price
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
for i, brand in enumerate(brands):
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax3.scatter(brand_data['weight_grams'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, color=colors[i])
ax3.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Price vs Weight by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(fontsize=8)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Sensor type distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax4.bar(range(len(sensor_counts)), sensor_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("Set2"))
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(sensor_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(sensor_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Camera Sensor Types', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Body type distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
colors_body = sns.color_palette("Set3")[:len(body_counts)]
ax5.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_body, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Max ISO comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df_sorted = df.sort_values('max_iso')
bars = ax6.barh(range(len(df_sorted)), df_sorted['max_iso'], 
                color=sns.color_palette("rocket", len(df_sorted)))
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(df_sorted)))
ax6.set_yticklabels([f"{row['brand']}\n{row['model_year']}" 
                      for _, row in df_sorted.iterrows()], fontsize=8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 7. 4K Video capability
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K']
colors_vid = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
ax7.pie(video_4k.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_vid, startangle=90)
ax7.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Brand comparison - average metrics
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
brand_avg_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax8.barh(brand_avg_price.index, brand_avg_price.values, 
                color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(brand_avg_price)))
ax8.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Average Price by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Lens mount distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
mount_counts = df['lens_mount'].value_counts()
ax9.bar(range(len(mount_counts)), mount_counts.values, 
        color=sns.color_palette("pastel"))
ax9.set_xticks(range(len(mount_counts)))
ax9.set_xticklabels(mount_counts.index, fontsize=10)
ax9.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_title('Lens Mount Types', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
